_comment: Kurosawa's own lines, in place of the King's (docs/modding.md, "racers": a boss's keys with his racer id after them).
{name} the racer; in the paper {p} the player, {r} the rival, {where} where it was raced, {rivalCar} and {playerCar} the cars.

talk.pulled_up.king.kurosawa: So you're the one they talk about at the summit. Your car against mine, down the pass. Now.
I heard you were fast. Pink slips, top to bottom, tonight.
replies.king.pink_slips.kurosawa: Pink slips. Take a good look at your car on the way down.
replies.king.no_pink_slip.kurosawa: I don't run the pass for money. Your car, or go home.
lines.street.king_out.kurosawa: {name} has heard about you. He's waiting at the summit, and he only races for pink slips.
lines.chat.fact.rival_king.kurosawa: You are the night wind of the passes, unbeaten downhill for ten years: the one everybody wants to beat.
news.king_beaten.kurosawa.headline: The Night Wind Falls
{p} Beats {r} Down the Pass
lines.news.king_beaten.kurosawa.body: {r} lost on the pass for the first time in ten years. {p} beat him {where} and drove off in his {rivalCar}.
news.king_won.kurosawa.headline: The Night Wind Still Blows
{r} Takes {p}'s Car
lines.news.king_won.kurosawa.body: {p} took a shot at {r} on the pass and lost, and the {playerCar} went with it. Ten years and counting.
